headline: Production Worker
workPreference: Open to Anything, Manufacturing & Production, Warehouse & Fulfillment
education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration - Business Development
summary: Hands-on, dependable worker with general production experience and a strong background in customer service and care roles. Picks up manual tasks quickly, follows routines carefully, and brings attentiveness and responsibility developed through years of caring for clients and serving customers. Prefers manual, hands-on work and is open to training and working multiple shifts, with a strong interest in manufacturing and production roles that value manual dexterity, consistency, and reliability.
qualifications: General production experience across a variety of machinery
Quick learner on hands-on, manual tasks and open to cross-training
Reliable and consistent, with a track record of trusted, independent work
Strong attention to detail, including following care routines and schedules carefully
Time management, including managing routes and timelines using GPS and mobile devices
Teamwork and customer service experience in restaurant, bar, and service settings
